claims.quote: we identified two rare missense variants in X-linked GRIA3 from male patients who showed syndromes featuring aggressive outbursts.
Both G630R and E787G mutations in AMPA receptor GluA3 completely lost their ion channel functions.

claims.object_text: longer guanine repeats suppress transcription of GRIA3
claims.quote: a guanine-repeat single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP, rs3216834) located in the first intron of human GRIA3 gene was found to regulate GluA3 expression with longer guanine repeats (rs3216834-10G/-11G) suppressing transcription compared to the shorter ones (-7G/-8G/-9G).
the distribution of rs3216834-10G/-11G was elevated in a male violent criminal sample from Chinese Han population.
Using GluA3 knockout mice, we showed that the excitatory neurotransmission and neuronal activity in the medial prefrontal cortex (mPFC) was impaired.

claims.object_text: impaired excitatory neurotransmission and neuronal activity in mPFC
claims.quote: Using GluA3 knockout mice, we showed that the excitatory neurotransmission and neuronal activity in the medial prefrontal cortex (mPFC) was impaired.

claims.object_text: GluA3 expression in mPFC alleviates aggressive behavior
claims.quote: Expressing GluA3 back into the mPFC alleviated the aggressive behavior of GluA3 knockout mice,
dysfunction of AMPA receptor GluA3 promotes aggressive behavior.
